The '''721a AEGIS shield generator''' was a model of [[reinforced shield generator]] made by [[Phoah-Kingsmeyer]] and available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The generator cost 3800 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
